title: 脚尖轻点三处
description: 成人单脚站在地面，另一脚轻点周围三块无字色盘。

art_direction.scene: A fictional adult balances on one foot on a flat exercise floor while the other toe lightly reaches toward a small colored disc nearby. Two additional discs sit at easy distances to the side and behind, all unlettered and flat. The supporting knee stays soft, hands open for balance, and a fixed wall rail is within comfortable reach. Frame the whole figure and the modest target spacing without a crowded background. Use a handmade clay-diorama illustration with modeled fictional adult figures, tactile walls, soft studio light, and warm terracotta and mint.
